mintAuthority.summary: lisUSD uses Maker-style wards() authorization with roles 1 = minter, 2 = manager, and 3 = admin. The 24-hour timelock is the hardcoded DEFAULT_ADMIN and owns the ProxyAdmin for the token and HayJoin; onlyAdmin also admits wards with role 3, whose complete membership is not established by the historical probe list. The manager Safe remains 3-of-6, and its role 2 can set the supply cap and update the domain separator, but cannot mint.

mintIncidents.summary: After the Ankr aBNBc infinite-mint exploit crashed the collateral's market price, an attacker borrowed about 16.4M HAY (now lisUSD) against near-worthless aBNBc because Helio's oracle still priced it at the Chainlink BNB feed, leaving roughly 19M HAY of bad debt through the issuance route.

controls.label: HayJoin CDP exit adapter (operational LISUSD minter ward, wards = 1)
controls.capDescription: LISUSD uses wards() Maker-style auth; mint() reverts with 'LisUSD/not-authorized-minter' unless caller is a ward with role 1. HayJoin mints only when users exit the CDP system, bounded by the supply cap (settable by the wards=2 manager Safe).
controls.evidence: At BSC block 103638487: wards(0x4c798f81…) = 1 on the LISUSD token (minter role). The contract is an EIP-1967 proxy whose implementation 0xe8a0c5… is Sourcify-verified as HayJoin (contracts/join.sol), the Maker-style join adapter that calls hay.mint() on CDP exit. Its proxy admin is the same ProxyAdmin 0x1fa3e471… owned by the 24h timelock. Recent mint check: the only Transfer-from-zero events in the last 500K blocks (~4 days, scanned in 10K-block chunks via bsc.drpc.org) entered via the CDP Interaction entry point (0x2078a1…, itself not a ward), consistent with HayJoin being the sole operational minter.

review.evidence: At BSC block 103638487 (2026-06-11): LISUSD (0x0782b6d8...) is an EIP-1967 proxy; impl = 0xf5bd9b19… (Sourcify-verified LisUSD); proxy admin = 0x1fa3e471… (owned by 24h timelock). The LisUSD source defines no Rely/Deny events. Correction from the same verified implementation source fetched 2026-10-01: rely/deny admit both the hardcoded DEFAULT_ADMIN and wards with role ADMIN (3); the historical address probes do not establish a complete ward census or exclude additional admins. Historically confirmed wards: timelock 0x07D274… = 1 (minter), HayJoin 0x4c798f81… = 1 (minter, the CDP exit adapter), manager Safe 0x8d3881… = 2 (3/6, guard present). The other ecosystem contracts in the historical probe list returned wards = 0, and a historical 500K-block mint scan found CDP Interaction to HayJoin mints. At BSC block 125055872 on 2026-10-01, token implementation and admin, HayJoin implementation and admin, ProxyAdmin owner, manager Safe owners/threshold, and timelock getMinDelay() = 86400 were unchanged. The historical event scan, guard and complete role membership were not re-certified. Economic-posture review from 2026-08-15 is retained: the manager Safe can raise the supply cap and no prudential supervisor or attestor is identified.
